name: Returning from unit workspace restores directory context and focus
title: SC-08-11-03 Returning from unit workspace restores directory context and focus
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the Site Manager has filtered the unit directory
When the manager opens the unit workspace from a directory row and returns
Then the directory filter and search query are preserved
And focus is restored to the initiating row action
